message: We've all been there: the lights flicker, and suddenly the kids think it's party time with a blackout! It can feel like a mini adventure, but it's good to have a plan in place so we can keep the fun and safety balanced. I found a handy resource that lays out some practical tips on handling power outages—perfect for when the kiddos get a bit too excited. Remember, a little preparedness can turn an unexpected blackout into a cozy family game night instead!
